Architecture rules for bugfix-feature-15-enrichment-stdin-and-model-fallbacks.

LAYER.ORDER: domain > application > infrastructure > control. Dependencies point inward only. The application layer decides retry and model rotation; adapters execute one bounded child process per call.

ARCH.HEX: ports live in pipelines/enrichment/src/main/scala/newspipe/application/ports/Ports.scala. The application layer depends on EnrichmentPort, never on OpenCodeCliClient. Model names are configuration passed through the port, not an infrastructure type.

ARCH.STDIN: no child process may inherit an open stdin pipe. Every ProcessBuilder in the enrichment pipeline redirects stdin from /dev/null, and the launcher starts sbt with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL. This rule is absolute: it does not depend on whether the parent stdin is a TTY, a pipe, or a file.

ARCH.MODEL: the enrichment model chain uses the same free, non-opencode provider family as the wave runner: nvidia/* only. The primary is nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b and the fallback is nvidia/poolside/laguna-xs-2.1. No opencode/* model may be reintroduced into conf/enrichment.conf.

ARCH.CLOCK: readiness bounds are wall-clock bounds. A gate that counts loop iterations instead of reading a clock violates maxWait and must not ship.

ARCH.DOTENV.MERGE: every runtime setting resolves in this order -- process environment, then a discovered .env, then conf/enrichment.conf. New settings follow the same three-tier precedence. .env is the operator's local file: the E2E check backs it up and restores it.

ARCH.SEVERITY: CRITICAL / MAJOR / MINOR / TRIVIAL. CRITICAL or MAJOR findings stop the chain.

APP.LANGUAGE: Scala 3.3.4, JDK 21, sbt for pipelines; Python 3 for scripts/newspipe. The PYTHON.* rules apply to scripts/newspipe only.

ARCH.NO_INFRA_EDIT: ~/Repos/pipeline_infra is a separate repository and is out of scope. Kafka partitioning is out of scope; raw_rss has one partition.

THREAD.SAFETY: OpenCodeCliClient holds only immutable constructor state and builds a fresh ProcessBuilder per call, so one instance may be shared across worker threads.

CONCURRENCY.BOUND: a poll batch is bounded by max.poll.records (20) and each item is bounded by max-attempts times timeout-seconds. The fallback chain does not add attempts; it selects the model for each existing attempt.

Legend.

CU IDs: cu-001, cu-002, ... executed in wave order.

STATUS values a Coder reports: COMPLETED, BLOCKED, ESCALATED.

SEVERITY: CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, TRIVIAL. CRITICAL or MAJOR must not be shipped.

Prove: a line under each implementation step is the command that demonstrates the step landed. Run it. A step without a passing Prove is not done.

Do NOT touch: an explicit list. Violating it is a CRITICAL finding.

Stop when: the stopping condition for a step. Do not proceed past it.

COORDINATES: DTR keys for the files a CU reads or changes. A key absent from the baseline DTR means the file is created by this CU.

REQUIREMENTS:
Deliver the configuration tier for the enrichment model chain. The tracked default must name the proven nvidia primary and one proven nvidia fallback, and EnvConfig must expose the fallback list through the same environment > .env > conf precedence the other opencode keys use.

```scala
package newspipe.application.services

import newspipe.application.ports.{DependencyProbe, ProbeResult}

import java.time.Instant
import scala.concurrent.duration.FiniteDuration

final case class ReadinessReport(ready: Boolean, failures: List[String]):
  def describe: String =
    if ready then "all dependencies ready"
    else failures.mkString("not ready: ", "; ", "")

final class ReadinessGate(
    probes: List[DependencyProbe],
    maxWait: FiniteDuration,
    interval: FiniteDuration,
    sleep: FiniteDuration => Unit,
    clock: () => Instant = () => Instant.now()
):
  def await(start: Instant): ReadinessReport =
    val deadline: Instant = start.plusMillis(maxWait.toMillis)
    var last: List[String] = Nil
    var continue: Boolean = true
    while continue do
      last = probes.flatMap: probe =>
        probe.check() match
          case ProbeResult.Ready => Nil
          case ProbeResult.NotReady(dep, detail) => List(s"$dep: $detail")
      if last.isEmpty then continue = false
      else if !clock().isBefore(deadline) then continue = false
      else sleep(interval)
    ReadinessReport(last.isEmpty, last)
```

```scala
package newspipe

import newspipe.application.ports.{DependencyProbe, ProbeResult}
import newspipe.application.services.ReadinessGate
import org.scalatest.funspec.AnyFunSpec
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers

import java.time.Instant
import scala.concurrent.duration.*

class ReadinessGateSpec extends AnyFunSpec with Matchers:
  private class FixedProbe(n: String, r: ProbeResult) extends DependencyProbe:
    def name: String = n
    def check(): ProbeResult = r

  private val instant: Instant = Instant.parse("2026-10-17T00:00:00Z")

  describe("ReadinessGate") {
    it("reports ready when every probe passes") {
      val gate = new ReadinessGate(
        List(FixedProbe("a", ProbeResult.Ready), FixedProbe("b", ProbeResult.Ready)),
        5.seconds, 1.second, _ => (), () => instant)
      gate.await(instant).ready shouldBe true
      gate.await(instant).failures shouldBe empty
    }

    it("names every failing dependency") {
      val gate = new ReadinessGate(
        List(
          FixedProbe("kafka", ProbeResult.NotReady("kafka", "cannot reach localhost:9092")),
          FixedProbe("object-store", ProbeResult.NotReady("object-store", "bucket missing"))
        ),
        5.seconds, 1.second, _ => (), () => instant)
      val report = gate.await(instant)
      report.ready shouldBe false
      report.failures.size shouldBe 2
      report.describe should include("kafka")
      report.describe should include("object-store")
    }

    it("returns not-ready rather than blocking past maxWait") {
      var slept: Int = 0
      val clock: () => Instant = () => instant.plusSeconds(slept.toLong)
      val gate = new ReadinessGate(
        List(FixedProbe("kafka", ProbeResult.NotReady("kafka", "down"))),
        2.seconds, 1.second, _ => slept += 1, clock)
      val report = gate.await(instant)
      report.ready shouldBe false
      slept should be <= 2
    }

    it("returns not-ready immediately when maxWait is zero") {
      val gate = new ReadinessGate(
        List(FixedProbe("kafka", ProbeResult.NotReady("kafka", "down"))),
        Duration.Zero, 1.second, _ => (), () => instant)
      gate.await(instant).ready shouldBe false
    }

    it("stops at maxWait of wall-clock time when a probe is slower than the interval") {
      var now: Instant = instant
      var checks: Int = 0
      var slept: Int = 0
      val slow = new DependencyProbe:
        def name: String = "slow"
        def check(): ProbeResult =
          checks += 1
          now = now.plusSeconds(30)
          ProbeResult.NotReady("slow", "down")
      val gate = new ReadinessGate(
        List(slow), 60.seconds, 2.seconds, _ => slept += 1, () => now)
      gate.await(instant).ready shouldBe false
      checks shouldBe 2
      slept shouldBe 1
    }
  }
```

```scala
package newspipe.infrastructure.llmdataenricher

import io.circe.parser.*
import newspipe.application.ports.EnrichmentPort
import newspipe.domain.models.{Enrichment, RssItem}
import newspipe.domain.valueObjects.{GeoArea, Urgency}

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import scala.concurrent.duration.FiniteDuration
import scala.util.Try

final class OpenCodeCliClient(timeout: FiniteDuration, binary: String = "opencode") extends EnrichmentPort:

  def enrich(item: RssItem, model: String): Either[Throwable, Enrichment] =
    Try {
      val prompt = OpenCodeCliClient.promptFor(item)
      val proc = OpenCodeCliClient.processBuilder(binary, model, prompt).start()
      val startNanos = System.nanoTime()
      val finished = proc.waitFor(timeout.toMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
      val elapsedSecs = (System.nanoTime() - startNanos) / 1000000000L
      if !finished then
        OpenCodeCliClient.killTree(proc)
        throw new RuntimeException(s"opencode run timed out after $elapsedSecs s; skipped item '${item.link}'")
      val stdout = new String(proc.getInputStream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
      if proc.exitValue() != 0 then
        throw new RuntimeException(s"opencode run exited ${proc.exitValue()}")
      OpenCodeCliClient.parseEvents(stdout)
    }.toEither

object OpenCodeCliClient:
  def processBuilder(binary: String, model: String, prompt: String): ProcessBuilder =
    new ProcessBuilder(binary, "run", "--format", "json", "--model", model, prompt)
      .redirectErrorStream(false)
      .redirectInput(ProcessBuilder.Redirect.from(new java.io.File("/dev/null")))

  def killTree(proc: Process): Unit =
    proc.descendants().forEach(_.destroyForcibly())
    proc.destroyForcibly()
    try proc.getInputStream.close() catch case _: Exception => ()
    try proc.getErrorStream.close() catch case _: Exception => ()
    try proc.getOutputStream.close() catch case _: Exception => ()
    val _ = proc.waitFor(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)

  def promptFor(item: RssItem): String =
    val stream = getClass.getClassLoader.getResourceAsStream("prompts/enrich.txt")
    require(stream != null, "prompts/enrich.txt missing from classpath")
    val template =
      try scala.io.Source.fromInputStream(stream, "UTF-8").mkString
      finally stream.close()
    template
      .replace("{{TITLE}}", item.title)
      .replace("{{LINK}}", item.link)
      .replace("{{DESCRIPTION}}", item.description)

  def parseEvents(ndjson: String): Enrichment =
    val text = ndjson.linesIterator.flatMap { line =>
      parse(line).toOption.flatMap(_.hcursor.downField("part").downField("text").as[String].toOption)
    }.mkString
    val start = text.indexOf('{')
    val end = text.lastIndexOf('}')
    if start < 0 || end <= start then
      throw new RuntimeException(s"no JSON object in opencode output: ${text.take(200)}")
```

```scala
package newspipe.infrastructure.llmdataenricher

import newspipe.application.ports.{CliReadinessProbe, ProbeResult}

import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import scala.concurrent.duration.FiniteDuration
import scala.util.Try

final class OpenCodeModelReadinessProbe(
    models: List[String],
    timeout: FiniteDuration,
    binary: String = "opencode"
) extends CliReadinessProbe:
  def name: String = "opencode-model"

  def check(): ProbeResult =
    val configured: List[String] = models.map(_.trim).filter(_.nonEmpty).distinct
    if configured.isEmpty then ProbeResult.NotReady(name, "no model configured")
    else
      val failures: List[String] = configured.flatMap(model => checkOne(model))
      if failures.size < configured.size then ProbeResult.Ready
      else ProbeResult.NotReady(name, failures.mkString("; "))

  private def checkOne(model: String): Option[String] =
    Try {
      val proc = new ProcessBuilder(binary, "run", "--format", "json", "--model", model, "reply with exactly: OK")
        .redirectErrorStream(true)
        .redirectInput(ProcessBuilder.Redirect.from(new java.io.File("/dev/null")))
        .start()
      val finished = proc.waitFor(timeout.toMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
      if !finished then
        OpenCodeCliClient.killTree(proc)
        Some(s"model '$model' did not answer within ${timeout.toSeconds} s")
      else
        val source = scala.io.Source.fromInputStream(proc.getInputStream)
        val text = try source.mkString finally source.close()
        if proc.exitValue() != 0 || text.contains("\"type\":\"error\"") then
          Some(s"model '$model' did not answer: ${text.take(200)}")
        else None
    }.getOrElse(Some(s"could not invoke $binary for model '$model'"))
```

```scala
package newspipe.application.services

import com.typesafe.scalalogging.LazyLogging
import newspipe.application.ports.{BronzeMergeSink, EnrichmentPort, RawConsumer}
import newspipe.domain.models.{BronzeUnit, Enrichment, RssItem}

import java.time.Instant
import java.util.concurrent.{ExecutorService, Executors, TimeUnit}
import scala.annotation.tailrec
import scala.concurrent.duration.*
import scala.concurrent.{Await, ExecutionContext, Future}

/** What one poll produced: rows merged, items enriched, items dropped. */
final case class PollReport(merged: Int, enriched: Int, failed: Int)

final class EnrichmentService(
    consumer: RawConsumer,
    enrich: EnrichmentPort,
    sink: BronzeMergeSink,
    models: List[String],
    workers: Int,
    maxAttempts: Int
) extends LazyLogging:
  private val RetryPauseMillis: Long = 2000L
  private val chain: List[String] =
    val configured: List[String] = models.map(_.trim).filter(_.nonEmpty).distinct
    if configured.isEmpty then throw new IllegalArgumentException("no enrichment model configured")
    else configured
  private val pool: ExecutorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(math.max(1, workers))
  private given ExecutionContext = ExecutionContext.fromExecutorService(pool)

  def close(): Unit =
    pool.shutdown()
    pool.awaitTermination(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
    ()

  /** Batches the poll across at most `workers` threads. Await uses Duration.Inf
    * because every task is bounded: maxAttempts times the per-item timeout. */
  def runOnce(now: Instant): PollReport =
    val items = consumer.poll()
    val futures: List[Future[Either[Throwable, Enrichment]]] =
      items.map(item => Future(attempt(item)))
    val results: List[Either[Throwable, Enrichment]] =
      Await.result(Future.sequence(futures), Duration.Inf)
    val paired = items.zip(results)
    val units: List[BronzeUnit] = paired.collect { case (it, Right(en)) => BronzeUnit.fromRss(it, en, now) }
    val failed: Int = paired.count(_._2.isLeft)
    val merged: Int = sink.merge(units)
    consumer.commit()
    PollReport(merged, units.size, failed)

  private def attempt(item: RssItem): Either[Throwable, Enrichment] =
    val total: Int = math.max(1, maxAttempts)
    @tailrec
    def loop(remaining: Int): Either[Throwable, Enrichment] =
      val used: Int = total - remaining
      val attemptNo: Int = used + 1
      val model: String = chain(used % chain.size)
      enrich.enrich(item, model) match
        case Right(en) => Right(en)
        case Left(err) if remaining > 1 =>
          logger.warn(s"enrichment attempt $attemptNo of $total failed for ${item.link} with $model: ${err.getMessage}")
          Thread.sleep(RetryPauseMillis)
          loop(remaining - 1)
        case Left(err) => Left(err)
    loop(total)
```
